column1: Alive without breath, as cold as death, never thirsty ever drinking, all in mail never clinking, ever travelling, never walking, mouth ever moving, never talking.  What am I?

column1: You cannot see me, hear me or touch me.  I lie behind the stars and alter what is real, I am what you really fear, Close your eyes and come I near. What am I?

column1: With painstaking care, you are able to decipher the message of the hieroglyphs, intermixed with diagrams of devils:                                                                                          Remember our Enemy, children, and never underestimate the danger they pose.  Though you will never see one during your journey, you must be forever vigilant against invasion from the Void once the Voyage has ended.  Mighty beyond words, the Enemy is nonetheless vulnerable after a Crossing, for their numbers are small and their defenses weak.  Use the energy weapons carried on the Ship to defeat them, and never, ever engage the Enemy with lesser weapons, or you will surely perish.
column2: “你费尽心力，终于解读出这些象形文字的信息，其中还夹杂着恶魔的图示：\n\n记住我们的敌人，孩子们，永远不要低估它们带来的危险。虽然你们在此次旅程中永远不会见到它们，但在航行结束之后，你们必须永远警惕来自虚空的入侵。敌人强大得难以言喻，然而在穿越之后它们却很脆弱，因为它们的数量稀少，防御薄弱。使用飞船上携带的能量武器来击败它们，绝不要、绝对不要用更差的武器与敌人交战，否则你们必死无疑。”

column1: With painstaking care, you are able to decipher the message of the hieroglyphs:                                                                                                                                                     Though the Crossing of the Void be a long and arduous journey, the land you find at the end will be sweet and unspoiled by ancestors or the Enemy.  Take heart that your children's children will live in a perfect world free of war, free of famine, and free of fear.  Remember your sacred duty to care for the Ship on her long Voyage and ensure her safe arrival in the Promised Land.  Tend well the Guardian and house it securely away from the ship lest both be lost in a single misfortune.
column2: “你费尽心力，终于解读出这些象形文字的信息：\n\n虽然穿越虚空是一段漫长而艰苦的旅程，但你们在终点找到的土地将会甜美宜人，未被祖先或敌人玷污。请振作起来：你们子孙的子孙将生活在一个完美的世界里，没有战争，没有饥荒，也没有恐惧。记住你们的神圣职责：在漫长的航行中照料好飞船，确保它安全抵达应许之地。好好照看守护者，并将它与飞船妥善隔开安置，以免两者在一次灾祸中一同毁灭。”

column1: Before entering the Planetary Reaction Chamber, please request a pair of Safety Goggles from one of our Drones.  During peak hours of operation, this facility can generate enough power to produce a light bright enough to be seen from space.  Please avoid looking directly into the light.
column2: 进入行星反应室之前，请向我们任意一台无人机索取一副护目镜。在运行高峰期，本设施可以产生亮度足以从太空中看见的光。请避免直视光源。

column1: Blaster weapons provide an effective, accurate ranged attack.  To operate the blaster, hold the grip comfortably in your hand, point the barrel at your target, and gently squeeze the trigger.  Should the weapon misfire, do not look into the barrel- give the weapon to an instructor and let them fix the problem.  Never point a blaster at something you do not want to vaporize.
column2: 迷你榴弹枪能提供有效而精准的远程攻击。使用迷你榴弹枪时，请将握把舒适地握在手中，把枪口对准目标，然后轻轻扣动扳机。若武器发生故障，请勿朝枪管内张望——把武器交给教官，让他们来处理问题。绝不要把迷你榴弹枪对准任何你不想气化的东西。

column1: Chief Engineer Wilson's Personal Log.  I have locked myself in Storage Room #6 but currently have no means of escape.  The drone-bots have gone mad and have started killing everyone in sight.  I was able to access the main control terminal on Level Four despite warnings of a hazardous leak, and I sent a distress signal, but since we have not had contact with any of the colonies for several weeks, I do not believe that a rescue is possible.  I have also managed to seal this facility so that the drones can not escape.  It is my hope that the colonists will be able to mount some sort of defense by the time my encryption codes are broken.  Tell Emma I love her.  Wilson out.
column2: “首席工程师威尔逊的私人日志。我把自己锁在 6 号储藏室里，目前无路可逃。那些无人机已经失控，开始见到谁就杀谁。尽管有危险泄漏的警告，我还是设法接入了第四层的主控制终端，并发出了一封求救信号；但我们已经好几周没和任何一个殖民地取得联系了，所以我认为救援已无可能。我还设法封闭了这座设施，让那些无人机逃不出去。我希望等到我的加密密码被破解时，殖民者们已经能够组织起某种防御。告诉艾玛我爱她。威尔逊，完毕。”

column1: Hello and welcome to this self-guided tour of the Varn Planetary Control Facility.  We gladly welcome all visitors.  As you arrive at each key area, be sure to check any of our display screens for more information.  Enjoy your tour!
column2: “你好，欢迎参加这次维兰行星控制设施的自助导览。我们欢迎所有访客。每当你抵达一个关键区域，请务必查看我们的显示屏幕以了解更多信息。祝你游览愉快！”

column1: The room to your left is the main meeting hall.  Visiting dignitaries from around the world have feasted at banquets held in their honor.  In fact, it is said that at his 21st birthday party King Sheridan nearly choked to death on a piece of mogred, but was saved by a serving girl who he later married and made his Queen.  Ahh, l'amour.
column2: “你左边的房间是主会客厅。来自世界各地的贵宾都曾在此享用为他们举办的宴会。据说，谢里丹国王在 21 岁生日宴上差点被一块莫格肉噎死，幸好一位女侍救了他；后来他娶了她，并立她为王后。啊，爱情。”

column1: This is the main equipment storage and repair facility.  By now, you may have noticed several floating Drone-bots.  They are responsible both for maintaining the key systems of this facility as well as sanitation.  If a unit becomes damaged, it is brought here to be repaired.
column2: “这里是主要的设备储藏与维修设施。到了现在，你可能已经注意到好几台漂浮的无人机了。它们既负责维护本设施的关键系统，也负责清洁卫生。若有机器受损，就会被送到这里维修。”

column1: Warning, intruder alert, Level Four, Section.  All drones proceed to Level Four to intercept intruders.  Reactor is offline.  Encryption integrity at 2.064%.  Warning, intruder alert, Level Four…

column1: The air smells stale and makes you cough.
column2: 空气闻起来污浊不堪，让你咳嗽起来。

column1: The vent brings in fresh air.
column2: 通风口送来了新鲜空气。

column1: As you pull the lever rocks fall from above.
column2: 你一拉下拉杆，岩石便从上方落下。

column1: Even though the water is dirty it still refreshes.
column2: 水虽然脏，却仍让你精神一振。

column1: Small rocks and debris fall from above.
column2: 小石块和碎屑从上方落下。

column1: Some loose debris overhead falls on you.
column2: 头顶上一些松动的碎石落到了你身上。

column1: The dirty water leaves a bad taste in your mouth.
column2: 脏水在你嘴里留下难闻的味道。

column1: The mine shakes and shifts around you.
column2: 矿洞在你周围摇晃、移位。

column1: The switch is locked in place.
This cave-in blocks any further access into the mine.
column2: 这场塌方堵死了进入矿洞的后续道路。

column1: You mine the gold with no problem.
You were fast enough to dodge the bigger rocks.
column2: 你反应够快，躲开了那些较大的岩石。

column1: A voice whispers -I am the spirit of the swamp, congratulations, take what you may and leave in peace-
column2: “一个声音低语道——我是沼泽之灵，恭喜你，能拿什么就拿什么，然后平安离开吧——”

column1: You drink the water, with no effect.
A voice hisses -Walk the path of the snake-.
column2: 一个声音嘶嘶说道——走蛇之路——。

column1: Hundreds of snakes crawl out of the floor and bite you.
column2: 数百条蛇从地板里钻出来咬你。

column1: Swamp gas forces you back couching and gagging.
column2: 沼气逼得你一边咳嗽一边干呕，连连后退。

column1: The torches Ignite and so does the swamp gas.
column2: 火把点燃了，沼气也跟着烧了起来。

column1: There is a strong smell of gas pervading the air.
column2: 空气中弥漫着浓烈的瓦斯味。

column1: Barrel is filled with crystal shards (worthless).
column2: 桶里装满了水晶碎片（一文不值）。

column1: Someone has gone to a lot of trouble carving all these murals
column2: 有人费了好大功夫才刻出这些壁画

column1: The cabinet is filled with old and broken harvesting tools.
column2: 柜子里塞满了破旧不堪的采收工具。

column1: The sacks are filled with flawed crystal shards (worthless).
column2: 麻袋里装满了有瑕疵的水晶碎片（一文不值）。

column1: This razor sharp crystal is too immature to harvest.
column2: 这块锋利如刃的水晶还太嫩，无法开采。

column1: You mine the crystal in its raw form (+300 gold).
column2: 你以原石形态采出了水晶（+300 金币）。

column1: You refine the crystal you harvested (+200 to its value).
column2: 你提纯了采到的水晶（价值 +200）。

column1: You see a scattered of refining tools and small crystal shavings.
column2: 你看到散落一地的提纯工具和细小的水晶碎屑。

column1: You study the mural and get a good feeling inside.
column2: 你仔细端详壁画，心中涌起一股美好的感觉。

column1: A scrawled message on the brick reads   2=1  3=2  1=3
A strange force reaches out of the wall and grabs you.
column2: 一股奇怪的力量从墙里伸出来，抓住了你。

column1: Something slimey moves behind this brick wall.
column2: 这面砖墙后面有黏滑的东西在移动。

column1: The bones seems to charge with electricity !!.
column2: 那些骨头似乎通上了电！！

column1: There's nothing but spikes in the Iron maiden.
column2: 铁处女里除了尖刺什么都没有。

column1: These are really old bones...really old.
column2: 这些骨头真的非常古老……非常古老。

column1: With some muscle you move the switch down.
column2: 你使出些力气，把开关扳了下去。

column1: You find some half decent food in the sack.
column2: 你在麻袋里找到一些还算不错的食物。

column1: You flip the switch and hear grating off in the distance.
column2: 你扳动开关，听见远处传来刺耳的摩擦声。

column1: You gain knowledge from these ancient bones.
column2: 你从这些古老骸骨中学到了知识。

column1: You get a bad feeling from the bones.
column2: 这些骨头让你心生不祥之感。

column1: You search the Burial niche and find some gold.
column2: 你搜查了葬龛，找到了一些金币。

column1: You search the body and find some gold.
column2: 你搜查了尸体，找到了一些金币。
